# Conflict Rule 1 - Do Not Breach Arrivals Safe Zone:
[color=red]The Bus dock hallway and Arrival Areas are considered safe zones and absolutely no antag activity or griefing is permitted within that zone.[/color]
\n
The rest of The Outpost is completely open to antagonists, but this area (to prevent dying on round entry) is not. This means that the bus hallway must not be:
- Destroyed, or modified in a way that would endanger visitors
- Restricted from traffic.
- Destroying the bus to the Arrivals space is strictly forbidden as well
